title: Tiny, cute paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='42' ry='12' fill='#2E7BD6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='77' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#4E9BE8'/>
  <path d='M14 78 Q22 72 30 78 T46 78 T62 78 T78 78 T90 78' fill='none' stroke='#9FD0FF' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- boat hull: folded paper, front half -->
  <path d='M18 66 L50 44 L82 66 Z' fill='#FFF3D6'/>
  <!-- hull inner fold shadow -->
  <path d='M50 44 L82 66 L50 70 Z' fill='#E8D2A8'/>
  <!-- sail / center fold peak -->
  <path d='M50 44 L50 22 L58 40 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M50 44 L50 22 L42 40 Z' fill='#F5E4BC'/>
  <!-- fold line accents -->
  <path d='M50 44 L50 70' stroke='#D9BE8C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 66 L50 70' stroke='#D9BE8C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 66 L50 70' stroke='#D9BE8C' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hull edge highlight -->
  <path d='M18 66 L50 44' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cute face on hull -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='2.6' fill='#3A2E1E'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='2.6' fill='#3A2E1E'/>
  <circle cx='40.8' cy='59.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60.8' cy='59.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M45 64 Q50 68 55 64' fill='none' stroke='#3A2E1E' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='62' r='2.2' fill='#F7B8C4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='62' r='2.2' fill='#F7B8C4'/>
</svg>
